# Cost Observer

Private Railway usage history, advisory project budgets and read-only cost inspection. Pre-release.

- /openapi.json: REST interface contract
- /capability-manifest.json: implemented capabilities and limitations
- /api/health: liveness
- /api/ready: readiness

Requires the deployer's own Railway workspace/account token and hosting resources. No maintainer credentials or paid AI calls. No mutations to Railway. Costs are estimates, not invoice totals. Authentication is required for billing data.
